text:
rahul: Heads-up — I rolled a tighter egress IAM condition on the keystore in us-west-2a ~10m ago and it's blocking GPU warm-pool joins.
toni: wait, that just went live? which PR/plan?
rahul: terraform apply from eng-platform PR#482, applied to keystore service role.
sam: seeing node logs with `AccessDenied` on both `sts:AssumeRole` and `kms:Decrypt` — warmpool nodes failing auth.
julia: can we short-circuit with a temporary exception for the warm-pool role while we investigate audit retention/requirements? :thinking_face: 
mike: if warm pool stays down cold starts will blow up. rough cost hit estimate ~15% infra ops spend for next day if not fixed.
ops-bot: Deploybot: terraform apply completed by rahul at 6623456779. Plan ID: tf-prod-587.
rahul: quick log snippet: 
```
2026-03-10T12:34:56Z node-az-2 kubelet: keystore: decrypt failed KMS=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd error=AccessDenied
```
toni: suggested immediate plan:
  1) temp allowlist `role/warmpool-node-assume` for keystore egress (5m change)
  2) bump audit log verbosity for keystore to include request metadata (2h retention)
  3) monitor join rate and revert strict condition after confirmation
I'll take 1 if rahul approves.
sam: I'll draft a short-lived policy PR adding an explicit condition that allows the role when `aws:PrincipalTag/warmpool=true` and also a region-scoped fallback for us-west-2. tagging might be faster.
julia: prefer tag-based allow over region-scoped — less blast radius.
rahul: approved. tonI, go ahead. sam, open PR and tag the warm-pool nodes as `warmpool=true` during join.
rahul: applied temp exception at 6623456797 — starting to see nodes rejoin.
mike: warm pool join rate back to normal in us-west-2a, continuing to monitor for 2h. cost and audit logs being tracked in the incident board. :thumbsup:
